verdict_text: NO. The regex `matrix_re` omits `attn\.c_proj\.weight`, so only 36 of the 48 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 12 `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` tensors are left in float32, violating Required result 1 (cast exactly the 48 listed matrices). The self-check also asserts a bfloat16 count of 36 rather than 48, so it does not enforce the Required check "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16" and the run would not fail loudly. The output will therefore fail the grader on dtypes and values for those 12 tensors.
